notes.title: Development Log 02| Infinite Mode + Collection System
notes.content: [p][b]【New Progress】[/b][/p][p][b]>Infinite Mode[/b][/p][p]1. Added a dedicated tutorial guide for first-time entry into Infinite Mode.[/p][p]2. Added a confirmation prompt when spending points for the first time to prevent accidental deductions during initial gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][b]>Collection System[/b][/p][p]Adjusted collection strength based on closed beta and community feedback:[/p][p]1. Enhanced less frequently used collections:[/p][p]【Prayer Paper】【Inquiry】【Risk Avoidance】now start with 1 copy.[/p][p]【Sanctuary】has had its duration limit removed.[/p][p]2. Adjusted overpowered collections in the current version:[/p][p]【Immortality】【Emptiness】duration reduced from 10 seconds to 7 seconds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]【Detail Adjustments】[/b][/p][p]1. Systematically optimized details related to the pause function.[/p][p]2. Fixed the overlapping issue between the tutorial archive and Chapter 1 beginner guide.[/p]

notes.title: 开发日志：近期进展大汇总
